ModMetaData.name: D12 Fabulous Ghouls
ModMetaData.author: D12caEdro
ModMetaData.description:
Um… so… ghouls can grow back a whole spine after an arrow, but not even one tiny hair on their shiny noggins? That’s just silly, right? And no one thought of giving them wigs? Hmph… looks like those jealous sanguophages didn’t like being outshined by these humble kiddos. Well… that ends today! 
This mod lets every hairstyle in RimWorld be used by ghouls… making them truly fabulous little entities.
Roll content check:
(50) At least fifty hairstyles for ghouls right away. (?) Even more if you’ve got DLCs or mods that add more hair.
Requires:
Anomaly (dlc)
Load order tip:
Just drop this after any mod that adds hairstyles.
Special thanks (slimy hugs forever):
Marnador – the grounded astronaut who shared RimWordFont4, the sparkly font magic I used for my thumbnails.
